children.title: March 3rd Directions for World Cultures: READ HERE
children.content:
Happy Friday! I am not at school today but I have your instructions on what to do below. All work must be completed by the end of class and you must go in order!

  1. Bell Ringer- Check In Google Form
  2. Complete SWANA Quiz. Your quiz is open notes and you are given two attempts, I will take the higher score. Your quiz will automatically submit at the end of class. As always, NO TALKING during your quiz
  3. After your quiz, you have an Edpuzzle titled "The Israel-Palestine Conflict". This video might be taken for a grade and will help you on your test next week so pay attention. You can use headphones or closed captioning. I have uploaded the video into Schoology but if you cannot access it, just go through Edpuzzle
  4. After completing all assignments, click on this link to review 
  5. As always, BE YOUR BEST SELF. I am out sick and would love to come back Monday to a great report on all of my classes. Have a great weekend!

children.title: East Asia Theme
children.content: Because of its location in the far East, China and other East Asian countries have a rich history and set of traditions. Their philosophies of Confucianism, Taoism, and Buddhism have shaped their society and government. Today they are rapidly growing economic and political powers and have global impact. Some countries have retained Communist systems, but others are adapting to more free market systems. Some of the countries are more economically developed and have more democratic processes (South Korea, Japan), while others are still challenged by dictatorships and oppression (China, North Korea).
